scope: Six deployed UI interaction/keyboard checks; actual Playwright reporter summary with environment/configuration/attachments omitted.

tests.title: homepage preview switches perspective and opens the chosen demonstration
competency explorer filters, inspects evidence and changes display
workspace command search is keyboard accessible and routes to the matching competency
course discovery sorts, filters, compares and switches layout
demo perspective switcher changes workspace without granting live privileges
mobile navigation traps keyboard focus, dismisses with Escape and restores the trigger

transport_caveat: Browser used the environment proxy and ignored its interception certificate; independent curl HTTPS health check verified normally. Not a TLS security audit.
